_comment: C0-12 zapier bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」1 行带 .md 链接（make），related 写 1 条。

axes.model_access: AI capabilities (Zapier AI / Canvas / Agents) reach each vendor's models through the platform; the specific model list has not been verified item by item. The platform's main axis is 6000+ app integrations (the official figure not verified item by item).
axes.runtime: Pure cloud-hosted SaaS: Zaps/workflows run on Zapier's cloud; no self-hosted form.
axes.local_files: It hosts no local files; data flows between SaaS services via connectors and is processed on Zapier's cloud.
axes.background: Cloud hosting is naturally resident: scheduling, webhooks and delay queues are all official capabilities carried by the platform.
axes.tools: The connector ecosystem is the core asset; in the official help-center and license-FAQ framing, MCP/AI agents are one of Zapier's supported access surfaces (Zapier also provides MCP-side integrations; details not verified item by item).
axes.context: Data passing and Paths between multi-step Zaps are the official context-organization main axis; cross-task persistent memory mechanisms — no official documentation found (unknown means unknown).
axes.permissions: The enterprise line offers SSO/auditing etc. (official product-page framing); connector credentials are hosted and stored by the platform. Data-compliance lines (SOC 2 etc.) — official claims not verified item by item.
axes.fit: Fits: SaaS-ecosystem automation as the main axis, hanging AI agents on ready-made connectors, never touching deployment. Does not fit: data that must not leave your own environment; free unlimited self-hosting.

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The closest test protocol is the code-side [protocols/framework/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/framework/_protocol.md) (the tool-calling and credential-boundary sections are reusable; no workflow-platform-specific protocol exists on this site yet).
unknowns:
- The model catalog connected by AI features (not verified item by item)
- The current official framing of "6000+ apps" (not verified item by item)
- Cross-task memory mechanisms (no official documentation found)
related: Both connector-ecosystem automation platforms: Make's canvas is more "flowchart", Zapier more "forms + directory".
sources: Zapier · official homepage (AI/Canvas/Agents narrative entry point)
